estimand: 252 times session-weighted mean aligned daily net strategy-minus-momentum return difference; no real inputs
family: Four one-sided paired-mean tests with Holm; robustness positivity and economic materiality remain separate required conditions. No endpoint deletion.
size_gate: Every null raw-size and four-family FWER Wilson95 upper <=0.10
coverage_gate: Stationary/common-mean worlds: 95% paired-mean interval coverage Wilson95 lower >=0.90; violations retained as diagnostics
power_screen: Primary Holm power Wilson95 lower >=0.50 at +0.10 annual effect; separately require >=0.50 at +0.02 for adequacy at the materiality floor
selection: First candidate passing all mandatory size/coverage/power gates AND separately justified dependence assumptions; otherwise no selection. Synthetic pass alone cannot certify real assumptions.
failures: Invalid/zero variance or resample errors retain p=1 and uncovered/infinite-width intervals; never remove failed effects/replications
source_access: Existing archived source and offline calendar metadata only; no real returns, acceleration, dates changed or EXP005 registration
limitations: Only two36-month windows; annual bandwidth may be too large for available sample; persistent/shifted worlds can invalidate stationary inference. Calendar sample counts are not effective-size or power certificates. Original protocols unchanged.
